_comment: User-editable car spec registry. Loaded by car_spec_for() if present. Keys are LFS short car names (3-6 chars). Use this to add mod cars or override official defaults. Fields not provided fall back to CarSpec defaults.

_schema.cg_height_m: centre of gravity height above ground, in m
_schema.mu_lat: peak lateral tyre coefficient (~0.95 road, ~1.4 slicks+wing)
